# Security

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Email Gregory M. Kurtzer at `gmkurtzer@gmail.com` or `gmk@ciq.com` with the
subject `[WALDO security]`. Include the affected commit, impact, and the
smallest safe reproduction you can provide. Remove credentials, private paths,
and sensitive corpus content from the report.

WALDO is under active development and does not yet publish supported release
branches. Reports against the current `main` branch are welcome.
